method: Native SVG variations of the current app logo. Fivefold shutter structure retained; sharp edges and geometric cuts explored.

variants.name: Flat cut
variants.summary: The current five-blade geometry with flat ends and crisp mitred bends.

variants.name: Faceted shutter
variants.summary: Angular outer edges and straight, clean optical cuts.

variants.name: Pointed shutter
variants.summary: Curved shoulders paired with sharper chiseled blade tips.

variants.name: Bold shutter
variants.summary: Broader compact blades with sharp cuts and a stronger silhouette.

variants.name: Open shutter
variants.summary: More open optics and lighter, precisely cut blades.

variants.name: Angular iris
variants.summary: Five faceted blades arranged around an angular optical opening.
